title: Pure Fur Hire
summary: Pure Fur Hire with the 2026 Burst Protocol wave and generic staples. Each small Fur Hire Special Summons another from the hand and triggers a bonus effect whenever another Fur Hire is Special Summoned to your field, chaining one summon into a full board.

summary.title: Starters
points: Whirlwind Fur Hire activates on an empty field to Special Summon a Level 4 or lower Fur Hire from the Deck, plus a second one if the opponent controls a monster.
Beat, Bladesman Fur Hire summons another Fur Hire from the hand and searches any Fur Hire monster (except itself) when that monster arrives.
Rex, Freight Fur Hire searches any Fur Hire Spell or Trap on summon, while Rex, Ride Fur Hire reveals itself in the hand to Special Summon both itself and another Fur Hire from the hand.
Fandora, the Flying Fighting Furtress searches a Fur Hire card on activation and boosts your monsters' ATK in battle.

summary.title: Opening: Whirlwind or Beat + Any Fur Hire
steps: Summon Beat, Bladesman Fur Hire and use its effect to Special Summon Rex, Freight Fur Hire from the hand.
Trigger Rex to search Fandora, the Flying Fighting Furtress or Rookie Fur Hire, and Beat to search Rafale, Champion Fur Hire or Rex, Ride Fur Hire.
Link Summon Keel, Shipwright Fur Hire to Set Furtive Techniques Fur Hire, Fur All Your Ultimate Moves directly from the Deck.
Extend with Rex, Ride Fur Hire or Filo, Messenger Fur Hire to climb into Folgo, Justice Fur Hire, which summons Donpa, Marksman Fur Hire or Recon, Scout Fur Hire from the Deck in Defense Position.

summary.title: Swarm & Trigger Chain
summary.text: Small Fur Hires turn every subsequent Special Summon on either turn into interaction or advantage: Donpa destroys a face-up card, Recon destroys a Set card, Seal returns a Fur Hire monster from the GY to the hand, Filo revives one in Defense Position, and Helmer discards a Fur Hire to draw a card. On the opponent's turn, Keel, Shipwright Fur Hire banishes itself from the GY or Mayhem Fur Hire revives a monster to set off Donpa and Folgo at Quick Effect speed.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Folgo, Justice Fur Hire summons a Fur Hire with a different Type from the Deck on Link Summon, and draws 1 card (or 3 cards if you control 3+ other Fur Hire monsters with different names) whenever a card the opponent controls is destroyed.
Rafale, Champion Fur Hire excavates cards equal to your other differently named Fur Hires to add 1 to hand, and discards a Fur Hire to negate a monster effect.
Wiz, Sage Fur Hire discards a Fur Hire to negate a Spell or Trap activation, while Dyna, Hero Fur Hire banishes cards from the opponent's GY on summon.
Donner, Dagger Fur Hire destroys 1 Fur Hire you control and 1 card the opponent controls, or tributes a monster to revive two Fur Hires.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Furtive Techniques Fur Hire, Fur All Your Ultimate Moves destroys or banishes opposing cards up to the number of differently named Fur Hires you control, immediately triggering Folgo's 3-card draw.
Rookie Fur Hire tributes a monster to summon a Fur Hire 1 Level higher or lower from the Deck or GY, dodging targeted negation on your normal summon.
Fandora, the Flying Furtress trades your normal draw for a Fur Hire search and can send itself to the GY with 5 different Fur Hires on field to wipe all cards the opponent controls.
